high_level_description: The image depicts a formal dinner event held at the White House. The table is set with plates, glasses, and cutlery, indicating a formal meal. There are several individuals seated around the table, all dressed in business attire. The men are wearing suits and ties, while the women are in dresses or blouses. The atmosphere appears to be cordial and professional, suggesting a diplomatic or business-related gathering.
